# Novapharm Innovation Technology

Novapharm Innovation Technology is an India-based pharmaceutical strategy and execution advisory firm.

Primary advisory areas:
- Portfolio and growth strategy
- Product development and CMC programme design
- Technology transfer and manufacturing strategy
- Market entry, market access and partner strategy
- Commercial readiness and launch planning
- Supply-chain resilience and strategic sourcing
- Digital, data and AI operating models for pharmaceutical businesses
- Licensing, partnership and diligence support

The firm is based in Vadodara, Gujarat, India and supports decision-making across India, the United Kingdom and international pharmaceutical markets.

Important scope note: website content is general information, not medical, legal, investment, patent or formal regulatory advice. Regulated activities and specialist opinions are delivered by appropriately qualified parties under separate engagement terms.

Canonical website: https://nit.novapharmhealthcare.com/
Business enquiries: bd@novapharmhealthcare.com
